## History

Phillips obtained his teaching position because his uncle was a school trustee. During his time at the school, he disciplined [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) for striking [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) with a slate by making her stand in front of the class, and later punished her for tardiness by forcing her to sit next to [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Phillips's latter punishment prompted [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to pack up her things and temporarily leave the school.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV.
